grammar.purpose: Identify the first point when something becomes possible
grammar.explanation: 直到 sets the boundary; 才 marks that the event did not happen earlier. Keep the actual sequence distinct from the order information is revealed.

examples.zh: 直到电话接通，他才知道我在门口。
examples.py: zhí dào diàn huà jiē tōng , tā cái zhī dào wǒ zài mén kǒu .
examples.en: Only when the call connected did he know I was at the entrance.

examples.zh: 直到她解释，我才发现自己想错了。
examples.py: zhí dào tā jiě shì , wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ xiǎng cuò le .
examples.en: Only after she explained did I realise I had been mistaken.

commonMistakes.wrong: 直到电话接通，他已经一直知道我在门口。
commonMistakes.right: 直到电话接通，他才知道我在门口。
commonMistakes.why: The original says the information became known then, not that it was known all along.

grammar.explanation: 原来 can introduce a discovery that changes an earlier belief. It differs from 原来的, which modifies something previously used or existing.

examples.py: yuán lái nǐ men huàn dì fāng le .

examples.zh: 原来他没看到，不是故意不回。
examples.py: yuán lái tā méi kàn dào , bù shì gù yì bù huí .
examples.en: So he had not seen it, rather than deliberately not replying.

commonMistakes.why: Use 原来 as the discovery marker; 原来的 needs a modified noun.

grammar.purpose: Describe an extreme that does not change a limit
grammar.explanation: 再 can set an imagined degree; 也不 or 也没 gives the unchanged limitation. Do not treat it as a report of something actually attempted.

examples.zh: 我再等，也看不到小厅里的人。
examples.py: wǒ zài děng , yě kàn bù dào xiǎo tīng lǐ de rén .
examples.en: However long I wait, I cannot see the people in the small hall.

examples.zh: 声音再大，也没办法让没电的手机响起来。
examples.py: shēng yīn zài dà , yě méi bàn fǎ ràng méi diàn de shǒu jī xiǎng qǐ lái .
examples.en: However loud the sound, it cannot make a dead phone ring.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我再等，也看不到小厅里的人，所以我已经等了一整天。
commonMistakes.right: 我再等，也看不到小厅里的人。
commonMistakes.why: An imagined extreme does not establish that a whole day of waiting occurred.

grammar.purpose: State a consequence if the preceding condition fails
grammar.explanation: In conversation, 不然 often means otherwise. The consequence can be a possibility rather than an asserted fact.

examples.zh: 幸好接了，不然你可能还在外面。
examples.py: xìng hǎo jiē le , bù rán nǐ kě néng hái zài wài miàn .
examples.en: Good thing I answered; otherwise you might still be outside.

examples.zh: 先确认一下，不然又要找错地方。
examples.py: xiān què rèn yī xià , bù rán yòu yào zhǎo cuò dì fāng .
examples.en: Confirm first; otherwise we may go to the wrong place again.

commonMistakes.wrong: 幸好接了，不然你可能还在外面，所以现在你仍在外面。
commonMistakes.right: 幸好接了，不然你可能还在外面。
commonMistakes.why: The otherwise clause describes the avoided possibility, not the present location.

grammar.explanation: 把 introduces what is being treated as something else; 当成 names that category or assumption. A following correction can separate the two.

examples.zh: 我把发过消息当成对方看过。
examples.py: wǒ bǎ fā guò xiāo xī dàng chéng duì fāng kàn guò .
examples.en: I treated sending the message as the other person having read it.

examples.py: tā bǎ chén mò dàng chéng tóng yì .

commonMistakes.wrong: 我把发过消息当成看过对方。
commonMistakes.right: 我把发过消息当成对方看过。
commonMistakes.why: The subject of having read is the other person, not someone looking at that person.

reading.title: 消息发了，不等于看了
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 这段短剧从林安走进小厅开始。陈宇说“你总算来了”，林安没有回答问候，先问为什么大家全在这里。只看开头，我以为林安迟到，陈宇已经等得不耐烦。可第二句提到大门口等了半个小时，我又把字幕往回拖了一点。原来林安早就来了，只是一直站在另一扇门外，难怪进来就问大家怎么都换了地方。
lines.py: zhè duàn duǎn jù cóng lín ān zǒu jìn xiǎo tīng kāi shǐ . chén yǔ shuō nǐ zǒng suàn lái le , lín ān méi yǒu huí dá wèn hòu , xiān wèn wèi shén me dà jiā quán zài zhè lǐ . zhǐ kàn kāi tóu , wǒ yǐ wéi lín ān chí dào , chén yǔ yǐ jīng děng de bù nài fán . kě dì èr jù tí dào dà mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí , wǒ yòu bǎ zì mù wǎng huí tuō le yī diǎn . yuán lái lín ān zǎo jiù lái le , zhǐ shì yì zhí zhàn zài lìng yī shàn mén wài , nán guài jìn lái jiù wèn dà jiā zěn me dōu huàn le dì fāng .
lines.en: The short scene opens with Lin An entering the small hall. Chen Yu says, 'You're finally here,' but she asks why everyone is there. At first I thought she was late and he'd grown impatient. Then she mentions waiting at the main entrance for half an hour, so I dragged the subtitles back a little. She'd arrived earlier but stood outside another door, which explained her first question.

lines.zh: 陈宇解释，大房间的灯坏了，大家十点零五分才决定换到小厅。他在决定以后发了消息，以为林安会从另一边进来。镜头没有让我们看见林安的手机，所以到这里，我们只能知道陈宇发过，不能直接知道她收到了。他说“你没看到”，也是在问，并不是已经知道答案。
lines.py: chén yǔ jiě shì , dà fáng jiān de dēng huài le , dà jiā shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn cái jué dìng huàn dào xiǎo tīng . tā zài jué dìng yǐ hòu fā le xiāo xī , yǐ wéi lín ān huì cóng lìng yī biān jìn lái . jìng tóu méi yǒu ràng wǒ men kàn jiàn lín ān de shǒu jī , suǒ yǐ dào zhè lǐ , wǒ men zhǐ néng zhī dào chén yǔ fā guò , bù néng zhí jiē zhī dào tā shōu dào le . tā shuō nǐ méi kàn dào , yě shì zài wèn , bìng bù shì yǐ jīng zhī dào dá àn .
lines.en: Chen explains that a broken light prompted the move at 10:05. He sent a message and expected Lin to use the other entrance. We have not seen her phone, so know only that he sent it, not that she received it. His question about seeing it is a question, not prior knowledge of the answer.

lines.zh: 林安说，自己十点上车的时候，手机已经没电。这个时间比换地方早了五分钟，也比消息发出早。她出门之前看的是原来的地址，到门口时自然还在找大房间。她没有看见大家，就怀疑陈宇忘了活动。这里可以理解她为什么这样想，却不能把她的怀疑当成陈宇真的忘了。
lines.py: lín ān shuō , zì jǐ shí diǎn shàng chē de shí hou , shǒu jī yǐ jīng méi diàn . zhè gè shí jiān bǐ huàn dì fāng zǎo le wǔ fēn zhōng , yě bǐ xiāo xī fā chū zǎo . tā chū mén zhī qián kàn de shì yuán lái de dì zhǐ , dào mén kǒu shí zì rán hái zài zhǎo dà fáng jiān . tā méi yǒu kàn jiàn dà jiā , jiù huái yí chén yǔ wàng le huó dòng . zhè lǐ kě yǐ lǐ jiě tā wèi shén me zhè yàng xiǎng , què bù néng bǎ tā de huái yí dàng chéng chén yǔ zhēn de wàng le .
lines.en: Lin’s phone died on boarding at ten, five minutes before the venue change and message. She had checked the original address before leaving, so still looked for the large room. Seeing nobody, she suspected Chen had forgotten. We can understand the suspicion without treating it as fact.

lines.zh: 门口的通知是第三个线索。陈宇以为贴了纸，后来到的人就能找到小厅。林安确实看见了纸，可风把纸吹起来，她没看清内容。如果我们只听“看见一张纸”，就会漏掉后半句。看见纸和读到通知不是同一件事，就像发过消息和对方看过消息也不是同一件事。
lines.py: mén kǒu de tōng zhī shì dì sān gè xiàn suǒ . chén yǔ yǐ wéi tiē le zhǐ , hòu lái dào de rén jiù néng zhǎo dào xiǎo tīng . lín ān què shí kàn jiàn le zhǐ , kě fēng bǎ zhǐ chuī qǐ lái , tā méi kàn qīng nèi róng . rú guǒ wǒ men zhǐ tīng kàn jiàn yī zhāng zhǐ , jiù huì lòu diào hòu bàn jù . kàn jiàn zhǐ hé dú dào tōng zhī bù shì tóng yī jiàn shì , jiù xiàng fā guò xiāo xī hé duì fāng kàn guò xiāo xī yě bù shì tóng yī jiàn shì .
lines.en: The entrance notice is a third clue. Chen expected later arrivals to find the small hall from it. Lin saw the paper, but the wind lifted it and she could not read the contents. Seeing paper differs from reading a notice, just as sending a message differs from the other person reading it.

lines.zh: 等到十点四十分，林安向门口一家店的老板借了电话。陈宇不认识这个号码，但还是接了，这才听见她在大门口。电话接通以后，两个人知道的内容才接上。他告诉她从哪里走，她走了五分钟到了小厅。前面的等待很长，并不是因为路很远，而是因为她没有新地址。
lines.py: děng dào shí diǎn sì shí fēn , lín ān xiàng mén kǒu yī jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn jiè le diàn huà . chén yǔ bù rèn shi zhè gè hào mǎ , dàn hái shi jiē le , zhè cái tīng jiàn tā zài dà mén kǒu . diàn huà jiē tōng yǐ hòu , liǎng gè rén zhī dào de nèi róng cái jiē shàng . tā gào sù tā cóng nǎ lǐ zǒu , tā zǒu le wǔ fēn zhōng dào le xiǎo tīng . qián miàn de děng dài hěn zhǎng , bìng bù shì yīn wèi lù hěn yuǎn , ér shì yīn wèi tā méi yǒu xīn dì zhǐ .
lines.en: At 10:40 Lin borrowed a shopkeeper’s phone. Chen answered an unfamiliar number and learned she was at the main entrance. Only then did their information connect. His directions brought her to the small hall in five minutes. The long wait resulted from lacking the new location, not a long walk.

lines.zh: 后面陈宇说，下次应该再等她回一句，不能发完就算了。林安也说应该早点借电话，别一直站在门外猜。我把这两句抄下来，又看了一遍前面的消息和通知：陈宇一直以为她已经知道，林安却以为大家忘了。朋友问哪一句可以改得早一点，我指了指“你没看到”，说换成先问她在哪里，也许那时就能找到人。
lines.py: hòu miàn chén yǔ shuō , xià cì yīng gāi zài děng tā huí yī jù , bù néng fā wán jiù suàn le . lín ān yě shuō yīng gāi zǎo diǎn jiè diàn huà , bié yì zhí zhàn zài mén wài cāi . wǒ bǎ zhè liǎng jù chāo xià lái , yòu kàn le yī biàn qián miàn de xiāo xī hé tōng zhī : chén yǔ yì zhí yǐ wéi tā yǐ jīng zhī dào , lín ān què yǐ wéi dà jiā wàng le . péng you wèn nǎ yī jù kě yǐ gǎi de zǎo yī diǎn , wǒ zhǐ le zhǐ nǐ méi kàn dào , shuō huàn chéng xiān wèn tā zài nǎ lǐ , yě xǔ nà shí jiù néng zhǎo dào rén .
lines.en: Chen Yu says next time he should wait for her reply instead of assuming sending a message is enough. Lin An says she should have borrowed a phone earlier. I copied those lines and reread the message and notice: Chen thought she knew; she thought everyone had forgotten. Asked which earlier line I'd change, I pointed to 'Didn't you see it?' Asking where she was might have helped them find her sooner.

lines.zh: 最后林安说，她今天已经把大门看够了。陈宇邀请她进来喝水，活动还没有开始。我觉得这句话有一点抱怨，也有一点开玩笑：她不想再等，可也没有直接离开。如果换一种语气读，它可能更生气。我们讨论时先保留这两种可能，再听前后的声音，而不是凭一个词替整段关系下结论。
lines.py: zuì hòu lín ān shuō , tā jīn tiān yǐ jīng bǎ dà mén kàn gòu le . chén yǔ yāo qǐng tā jìn lái hē shuǐ , huó dòng hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ . wǒ jué de zhè jù huà yǒu yī diǎn bào yuàn , yě yǒu yī diǎn kāi wán xiào : tā bù xiǎng zài děng , kě yě méi yǒu zhí jiē lí kāi . rú guǒ huàn yī zhǒng yǔ qì dú , tā kě néng gèng shēng qì . wǒ men tǎo lùn shí xiān bǎo liú zhè liǎng zhǒng kě néng , zài tīng qián hòu de shēng yīn , ér bù shì píng yī gè cí tì zhěng duàn guān xì xià jié lùn .
lines.en: Finally Lin jokes that she has seen enough of the main entrance. Chen invites her for water; the event has not started. Her line could combine complaint and humour: she does not want more waiting but does not leave. Different delivery could sound angrier. We retain possibilities and hear the context rather than judging the whole relationship from one word.

lines.zh: 这段短剧从林安走进小厅开始。陈宇说“你【总算】来了”，林安没有回答问候，先问为什么大家全在这里。只看开头，我以为林安迟到，陈宇已经等得不耐烦。可第二句提到大门口等了半个小时，我又把字幕往回拖了一点。原来林安早就来了，只是一直站在另一扇门外，难怪进来就问大家怎么都换了地方。
lines.py: zhè duàn duǎn jù cóng lín ān zǒu jìn xiǎo tīng kāi shǐ . chén yǔ shuō nǐ zǒng suàn lái le , lín ān méi yǒu huí dá wèn hòu , xiān wèn wèi shén me dà jiā quán zài zhè lǐ . zhǐ kàn kāi tóu , wǒ yǐ wéi lín ān chí dào , chén yǔ yǐ jīng děng de bù nài fán . kě dì èr jù tí dào dà mén kǒu děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí , wǒ yòu bǎ zì mù wǎng huí tuō le yī diǎn . yuán lái lín ān zǎo jiù lái le , zhǐ shì yì zhí zhàn zài lìng yī shàn mén wài , nán guài jìn lái jiù wèn dà jiā zěn me dōu huàn le dì fāng .
lines.en: The short scene opens with Lin An entering the small hall. Chen Yu says, 'You're finally here,' but she asks why everyone is there. At first I thought she was late and he'd grown impatient. Then she mentions waiting at the main entrance for half an hour, so I dragged the subtitles back a little. She'd arrived earlier but stood outside another door, which explained her first question.

lines.zh: 陈宇【解释】，大房间的灯坏了，大家十点零五分才决定换到小厅。他在决定以后发了消息，以为林安会从另一边进来。镜头没有让我们看见林安的手机，所以到这里，我们只能知道陈宇发过，不能直接知道她收到了。他说“你没看到”，也是在问，并不是已经知道答案。
lines.py: chén yǔ jiě shì , dà fáng jiān de dēng huài le , dà jiā shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn cái jué dìng huàn dào xiǎo tīng . tā zài jué dìng yǐ hòu fā le xiāo xī , yǐ wéi lín ān huì cóng lìng yī biān jìn lái . jìng tóu méi yǒu ràng wǒ men kàn jiàn lín ān de shǒu jī , suǒ yǐ dào zhè lǐ , wǒ men zhǐ néng zhī dào chén yǔ fā guò , bù néng zhí jiē zhī dào tā shōu dào le . tā shuō nǐ méi kàn dào , yě shì zài wèn , bìng bù shì yǐ jīng zhī dào dá àn .
lines.en: Chen explains that a broken light prompted the move at 10:05. He sent a message and expected Lin to use the other entrance. We have not seen her phone, so know only that he sent it, not that she received it. His question about seeing it is a question, not prior knowledge of the answer.

lines.zh: 我以为你已经收到。
lines.py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ yǐ jīng shōu dào .

lines.py: nǐ fā de shí hou , wǒ shǒu jī yǐ jīng méi diàn le .
lines.en: My phone was already dead when you sent it.

lines.zh: 我只看见消息发出去了。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ kàn jiàn xiāo xī fā chū qù le .

lines.zh: 那就不是看见我读过了。

lines.zh: 其实我在这边摆椅子。

lines.zh: 我在那边看大门。

lines.zh: 下次别看了，直接打电话。

extraReadings.title: Who knows what, and when?: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 消息发了，不等于看了 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 真相和我开始想的完全不同。
lines.py: zhēn xiàng hé wǒ kāi shǐ xiǎng de wán quán bù tóng .
lines.en: What actually happened was completely different from my first idea.

lines.zh: 故事没有立刻把真相告诉观众。
lines.py: gù shì méi yǒu lì kè bǎ zhēn xiàng gào sù guān zhòng .
lines.en: The story does not immediately tell the audience what happened.

lines.zh: 门上的纸是我们找到新地方的线索。
lines.py: mén shàng de zhǐ shì wǒ men zhǎo dào xīn dì fāng de xiàn suǒ .
lines.en: The paper on the door is a clue to finding the new venue.

lines.zh: 我把前面的线索重新看了一遍。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ qián miàn de xiàn suǒ chóng xīn kàn le yī biàn .
lines.en: I looked back over the earlier clues.

lines.zh: 关键是他当时还没有看到消息。
lines.py: guān jiàn shì tā dāng shí hái méi yǒu kàn dào xiāo xī .
lines.en: The key is that he had not seen the message then.

lines.zh: 这句话是理解后面反应的关键。
lines.py: zhè jù huà shì lǐ jiě hòu miàn fǎn yìng de guān jiàn .
lines.en: This sentence is key to understanding the later reaction.

lines.zh: 先说发生了什么，再分析为什么。
lines.py: xiān shuō fā shēng le shén me , zài fēn xī wèi shén me .
lines.en: First say what happened, then analyse why.

lines.zh: 我们分析了两个人知道的内容。
lines.py: wǒ men fēn xī le liǎng gè rén zhī dào de nèi róng .
lines.en: We analysed what the two people knew.

lines.zh: 按这个逻辑，发过消息就等于对方看过，可这不对。
lines.py: àn zhè gè luó jí , fā guò xiāo xī jiù děng yú duì fāng kàn guò , kě zhè bú duì .
lines.en: By that logic, sending a message means the other person read it, but that is wrong.

lines.zh: 故事的逻辑要和前面的事实接上。
lines.py: gù shì de luó jí yào hé qián miàn de shì shí jiē shàng .
lines.en: The story’s logic needs to connect with the earlier facts.

lines.zh: 这个误解来自两个人知道的事情不同。
lines.py: zhè gè wù jiě lái zì liǎng gè rén zhī dào de shì qíng bù tóng .
lines.en: The misunderstanding comes from the two people knowing different things.

lines.zh: 她误解了那句没说完的话。
lines.py: tā wù jiě le nà jù méi shuō wán de huà .
lines.en: She misunderstood the unfinished remark.

lines.zh: 我们暂时在小厅等。
lines.py: wǒ men zàn shí zài xiǎo tīng děng .
lines.en: We are waiting in the small hall for now.

lines.zh: 这段暂时没有告诉我们结果。
lines.py: zhè duàn zàn shí méi yǒu gào sù wǒ men jié guǒ .
lines.en: This section has not told us the result yet.

lines.zh: 我总算找到你们了。
lines.py: wǒ zǒng suàn zhǎo dào nǐ men le .
lines.en: I finally found you all.

lines.zh: 最后一次电话总算接通了。
lines.py: zuì hòu yī cì diàn huà zǒng suàn jiē tōng le .
lines.en: The final call finally connected.

lines.zh: 我居然在门口等了这么久。
lines.py: wǒ jū rán zài mén kǒu děng le zhè me jiǔ .
lines.en: I cannot believe I waited at the door so long.

lines.zh: 他居然还记得两年前说过的话。
lines.py: tā jū rán hái jì de liǎng nián qián shuō guò de huà .
lines.en: Surprisingly he still remembered something said two years earlier.

lines.zh: 手机没电，干脆借一个打电话吧。
lines.py: shǒu jī méi diàn , gān cuì jiè yī gè dǎ diàn huà ba .
lines.en: The phone is dead; let’s simply borrow one to make a call.

lines.zh: 她干脆把问题当面问清楚。
lines.py: tā gān cuì bǎ wèn tí dāng miàn wèn qīng chǔ .
lines.en: She decided to ask directly and settle the question.

lines.zh: 毕竟他没有看到消息，不能说他故意不来。
lines.py: bì jìng tā méi yǒu kàn dào xiāo xī , bù néng shuō tā gù yì bù lái .
lines.en: After all, he did not see the message; we cannot say he deliberately stayed away.

lines.zh: 毕竟第一次见面，我们先把地方说清楚。
lines.py: bì jìng dì yī cì jiàn miàn , wǒ men xiān bǎ dì fāng shuō qīng chǔ .
lines.en: After all, it is the first meeting; let’s make the location clear.

lines.zh: 我偶然在门口看见那个通知。
lines.py: wǒ ǒu rán zài mén kǒu kàn jiàn nà gè tōng zhī .
lines.en: I happened to notice the sign at the entrance.

lines.zh: 这次偶然的相遇让他们重新联系。
lines.py: zhè cì ǒu rán de xiāng yù ràng tā men chóng xīn lián xì .
lines.en: This chance meeting brought them back in touch.

lines.zh: 我怀疑自己是不是记错了地方。
lines.py: wǒ huái yí zì jǐ shì bú shì jì cuò le dì fāng .
lines.en: I wondered whether I had remembered the wrong place.

lines.zh: 她怀疑那个解释，但愿意先听完。
lines.py: tā huái yí nà gè jiě shì , dàn yuàn yì xiān tīng wán .
lines.en: She doubted the explanation but was willing to hear it out.

lines.zh: 事实是两个人都到了，只是不在同一个地方。
lines.py: shì shí shì liǎng gè rén dōu dào le , zhǐ shì bù zài tóng yī gè dì fāng .
lines.en: The fact is that both arrived, but at different places.

lines.zh: 我想把事实和自己的判断分开。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ shì shí hé zì jǐ de pàn duàn fēn kāi .
lines.en: I want to separate the facts from my judgment.

lines.zh: 你先解释一下为什么换了地方。
lines.py: nǐ xiān jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me huàn le dì fāng .
lines.en: First explain why the venue changed.

lines.zh: 这个解释还没有回答时间的问题。
lines.py: zhè gè jiě shì hái méi yǒu huí dá shí jiān de wèn tí .
lines.en: This explanation has not answered the timing question.

lines.zh: 下次换地方，我们要确认对方收到。
lines.py: xià cì huàn dì fāng , wǒ men yào què rèn duì fāng shōu dào .
lines.en: Next time we change venues, let’s confirm the other person received the update.

lines.zh: 他打电话确认门口是哪一扇门。
lines.py: tā dǎ diàn huà què rèn mén kǒu shì nǎ yī shàn mén .
lines.en: He called to confirm which entrance was meant.

lines.zh: 他这个表情不一定是在生气。
lines.py: tā zhè gè biǎo qíng bù yí dìng shì zài shēng qì .
lines.en: His expression does not necessarily mean he is angry.

lines.zh: 我只看见表情，没听见他说什么。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ kàn jiàn biǎo qíng , méi tīng jiàn tā shuō shén me .
lines.en: I saw the expression but did not hear his words.

lines.zh: 这个细节前面已经出现过。
lines.py: zhè gè xì jié qián miàn yǐ jīng chū xiàn guò .
lines.en: This detail appeared earlier.

lines.zh: 她补了一个我们没注意的细节。
lines.py: tā bǔ le yī gè wǒ men méi zhù yì de xì jié .
lines.en: She added a detail we had missed.

lines.zh: 活动期间，你可以来小厅找我。
lines.py: huó dòng qī jiān , nǐ kě yǐ lái xiǎo tīng zhǎo wǒ .
lines.en: During the event, you can find me in the small hall.

lines.zh: 放假期间，他们见了两次面。
lines.py: fàng jià qī jiān , tā men jiàn le liǎng cì miàn .
lines.en: They met twice during the holiday.

lines.zh: 出门之前，我看过原来的地址。
lines.py: chū mén zhī qián , wǒ kàn guò yuán lái de dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Before leaving, I checked the original address.

lines.zh: 你之前有没有告诉他换地方了？
lines.py: nǐ zhī qián yǒu méi yǒu gào sù tā huàn dì fāng le ?
lines.en: Had you told him about the venue change before that?

lines.zh: 接通电话之后，他才知道我们在小厅。
lines.py: jiē tōng diàn huà zhī hòu , tā cái zhī dào wǒ men zài xiǎo tīng .
lines.en: Only after the call connected did he know we were in the small hall.

lines.zh: 比赛之后，她才解释那个动作。
lines.py: bǐ sài zhī hòu , tā cái jiě shì nà gè dòng zuò .
lines.en: Only after the competition did she explain that gesture.

lines.zh: 只凭一个表情，很难判断他在想什么。
lines.py: zhǐ píng yī gè biǎo qíng , hěn nán pàn duàn tā zài xiǎng shén me .
lines.en: It is hard to judge his thoughts from one expression.

lines.zh: 先听完，再做判断。
lines.py: xiān tīng wán , zài zuò pàn duàn .
lines.en: Listen to the end before making a judgment.

lines.zh: 我们再观察一下他后面的动作。
lines.py: wǒ men zài guān chá yī xià tā hòu miàn de dòng zuò .
lines.en: Let’s observe what he does afterwards.

lines.zh: 她观察到门口的纸被风吹起来了。
lines.py: tā guān chá dào mén kǒu de zhǐ bèi fēng chuī qǐ lái le .
lines.en: She noticed the paper at the entrance blowing in the wind.

lines.zh: 门口有一个换地方的通知。
lines.py: mén kǒu yǒu yī gè huàn dì fāng de tōng zhī .
lines.en: There is a notice at the entrance about the venue change.

lines.zh: 他通知了群里的人，却没有等回复。
lines.py: tā tōng zhī le qún lǐ de rén , què méi yǒu děng huí fù .
lines.en: He notified the group but did not wait for replies.

extraReadings.title: The viewer’s timeline
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 看这段短剧时，我把纸分成三栏：观众知道什么，陈宇知道什么，林安知道什么。不是每一栏都要写满。有些信息后来才出现，有些一直没有说明。这样记下来，我发现开头最容易犯的错误，是把后来听到的解释放回前面，以为人物从一开始就应该知道。
lines.py: kàn zhè duàn duǎn jù shí , wǒ bǎ zhǐ fēn chéng sān lán : guān zhòng zhī dào shén me , chén yǔ zhī dào shén me , lín ān zhī dào shén me . bù shì měi yī lán dōu yào xiě mǎn . yǒu xiē xìn xī hòu lái cái chū xiàn , yǒu xiē yì zhí méi yǒu shuō míng . zhè yàng jì xià lái , wǒ fā xiàn kāi tóu zuì róng yì fàn de cuò wù , shì bǎ hòu lái tīng dào de jiě shì fàng huí qián miàn , yǐ wéi rén wù cóng yī kāi shǐ jiù yīng gāi zhī dào .
lines.en: I divided my notes into what the audience, Chen and Lin knew. Not every column needed filling: some facts appeared later and others remained unspecified. The common mistake was putting a later explanation back into the beginning and assuming the characters should always have known it.

lines.zh: 在陈宇说发了消息的时候，他知道灯坏了，也知道活动换地方。他不知道林安的手机十点已经没电，更不知道她正站在大门口。林安知道原来的地址，知道自己等了很久，却不知道小厅里的人刚摆好椅子。两个人都不是毫无原因地生气，只是各自看到的事情不完整。
lines.py: zài chén yǔ shuō fā le xiāo xī de shí hou , tā zhī dào dēng huài le , yě zhī dào huó dòng huàn dì fāng . tā bù zhī dào lín ān de shǒu jī shí diǎn yǐ jīng méi diàn , gèng bù zhī dào tā zhèng zhàn zài dà mén kǒu . lín ān zhī dào yuán lái de dì zhǐ , zhī dào zì jǐ děng le hěn jiǔ , què bù zhī dào xiǎo tīng lǐ de rén gāng bǎi hǎo yǐ zi . liǎng gè rén dōu bù shì háo wú yuán yīn de shēng qì , zhǐ shì gè zì kàn dào de shì qíng bù wán zhěng .
lines.en: When Chen mentions his message, he knows about the light and move, but not Lin’s dead phone or waiting position. Lin knows the old address and her long wait, but not that the others are just setting up chairs. Their reactions have reasons, but each has incomplete information.

lines.zh: 观众也不是从开头就比所有人知道得多。我们先看见林安走进来，听见陈宇说“总算”，容易跟着他觉得她来晚了。等她说在门口等，又容易立刻站到她那边。我暂停了一次，问自己前一个判断有没有被后面的事实改变。陈宇忘了活动这个说法，并没有在后面得到证明。
lines.py: guān zhòng yě bù shì cóng kāi tóu jiù bǐ suǒ yǒu rén zhī dào de duō . wǒ men xiān kàn jiàn lín ān zǒu jìn lái , tīng jiàn chén yǔ shuō zǒng suàn , róng yì gēn zhe tā jué de tā lái wǎn le . děng tā shuō zài mén kǒu děng , yòu róng yì lì kè zhàn dào tā nà biān . wǒ zàn tíng le yī cì , wèn zì jǐ qián yī gè pàn duàn yǒu méi yǒu bèi hòu miàn de shì shí gǎi biàn . chén yǔ wàng le huó dòng zhè gè shuō fǎ , bìng méi yǒu zài hòu miàn dé dào zhèng míng .
lines.en: The audience does not know everything from the start. Seeing Lin enter and hearing finally can lead us to side with Chen; hearing about her wait can reverse that. I paused to ask whether later facts changed my earlier judgment. The claim that Chen forgot the event was never confirmed.

lines.zh: 把时间写清楚以后，事情更容易理解。十点手机没电，十点零五分换地方并发消息，十点四十分借电话，五分钟后到小厅。林安说等了半个小时，所以她到大门口是在十点十分左右，不是十点半。这个时间来自电话和等待一起计算，不是她在对话里直接报了到达时间。
lines.py: bǎ shí jiān xiě qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , shì qíng gèng róng yì lǐ jiě . shí diǎn shǒu jī méi diàn , shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn huàn dì fāng bìng fā xiāo xī , shí diǎn sì shí fēn jiè diàn huà , wǔ fēn zhōng hòu dào xiǎo tīng . lín ān shuō děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí , suǒ yǐ tā dào dà mén kǒu shì zài shí diǎn shí fēn zuǒ yòu , bù shì shí diǎn bàn . zhè gè shí jiān lái zì diàn huà hé děng dài yì qǐ jì suàn , bù shì tā zài duì huà lǐ zhí jiē bào le dào dá shí jiān .
lines.en: A timeline helps: phone dead at ten, move and message at 10:05, borrowed call at 10:40, arrival five minutes later. A half-hour wait puts Lin at the main entrance around 10:10, not 10:30. That is an inference from the call and waiting duration, not an explicitly announced arrival time.

lines.zh: 不过我也注意到，人物口中的“半个小时”可能是大概的时间。我们能确定她等待很久，不能因此说她一定在十点十分零秒到达。讨论故事时，计算能帮我们发现顺序，但不应该把日常说话的大概数字变成不存在的准确记录。朋友说，他以前看字幕也常把“等了一百年”当成实际很久，其实那是在夸张。
lines.py: bù guò wǒ yě zhù yì dào , rén wù kǒu zhōng de bàn gè xiǎo shí kě néng shì dà gài de shí jiān . wǒ men néng què dìng tā děng dài hěn jiǔ , bù néng yīn cǐ shuō tā yí dìng zài shí diǎn shí fēn líng miǎo dào dá . tǎo lùn gù shì shí , jì suàn néng bāng wǒ men fā xiàn shùn xù , dàn bù yīng gāi bǎ rì cháng shuō huà de dà gài shù zì biàn chéng bù cún zài de zhǔn què jì lù . péng you shuō , tā yǐ qián kàn zì mù yě cháng bǎ děng le yī bǎi nián dàng chéng shí jì hěn jiǔ , qí shí nà shì zài kuā zhāng .
lines.en: Half an hour may be approximate. We know she waited a long time, not that she arrived at precisely 10:10:00. Calculations can clarify sequence without turning conversational estimates into exact records. My friend recalled exaggerations such as waiting a hundred years, not literal durations.

lines.zh: 再读最后几句，我发现解释已经从过去转向下一次。等回复、说清是哪扇门、发现不对就借电话，都比简单说“下次别迟到”更符合这段经历。因为迟到这个词没有说明为什么找错地方，也没有说明消息没有读到。我们给这一段取了个自己的名字：两个人都来了，信息却没见面。
lines.py: zài dú zuì hòu jǐ jù , wǒ fā xiàn jiě shì yǐ jīng cóng guò qù zhuǎn xiàng xià yī cì . děng huí fù , shuō qīng shì nǎ shàn mén , fā xiàn bú duì jiù jiè diàn huà , dōu bǐ jiǎn dān shuō xià cì bié chí dào gèng fú hé zhè duàn jīng lì . yīn wèi chí dào zhè gè cí méi yǒu shuō míng wèi shén me zhǎo cuò dì fāng , yě méi yǒu shuō míng xiāo xī méi yǒu dú dào . wǒ men gěi zhè yī duàn qǔ le gè zì jǐ de míng zi : liǎng gè rén dōu lái le , xìn xī què méi jiàn miàn .
lines.en: The ending turns from the past to next time: wait for a reply, specify the entrance, borrow a phone if things seem wrong. These fit the incident better than don’t be late, which misses the venue and unread message. We gave it our own title: both people arrived, but their information never met.

lines.zh: 朋友让我再讲一遍，不要照着每句字幕翻译。我先讲换地方的原因，再讲手机没电，最后讲那通电话怎样解决了问题。他提醒我，按事情发生的顺序讲和按短剧告诉观众的顺序讲不一样。我试了两个版本，听起来确实不同，但手机没电在消息之前这一点，在两个版本里都没有变。
lines.py: péng you ràng wǒ zài jiǎng yī biàn , bú yào zhào zhe měi jù zì mù fān yì . wǒ xiān jiǎng huàn dì fāng de yuán yīn , zài jiǎng shǒu jī méi diàn , zuì hòu jiǎng nà tōng diàn huà zěn yàng jiě jué le wèn tí . tā tí xǐng wǒ , àn shì qíng fā shēng de shùn xù jiǎng hé àn duǎn jù gào sù guān zhòng de shùn xù jiǎng bù yī yàng . wǒ shì le liǎng gè bǎn běn , tīng qǐ lái què shí bù tóng , dàn shǒu jī méi diàn zài xiāo xī zhī qián zhè yī diǎn , zài liǎng gè bǎn běn lǐ dōu méi yǒu biàn .
lines.en: My friend asked for a retelling without translating each subtitle. I described the venue change, dead phone and resolving call. He noted the difference between chronological events and the order the drama reveals them. I tried both; they sounded different, but the phone dying before the message remained true in each.

audio.py: dà fáng jiān de dēng huài le , shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn cái jué dìng huàn dào xiǎo tīng .
audio.en: The large room’s light broke. We only decided to move to the small hall at 10:05.

tasks.statement: The move was decided at 10:05 after the light broke.
tasks.why: Both cause and decision time are stated.

audio.zh: 没看到。我十点上车，手机就没电了。
audio.py: méi kàn dào . wǒ shí diǎn shàng chē , shǒu jī jiù méi diàn le .
audio.en: No. My phone died when I boarded at ten.

tasks.statement: Lin saw the new message before boarding at ten.
tasks.why: Her phone died at ten and she says she did not see it.

audio.zh: 门口的通知是第三个线索。陈宇以为贴了纸，后来到的人就能找到小厅。林安确实看见了纸，可风把纸吹起来，她没看清内容。如果我们只听“看见一张纸”，就会漏掉后半句。看见纸和读到通知不是同一件事，就像发过消息和对方看过消息也不是同一件事。
audio.py: mén kǒu de tōng zhī shì dì sān gè xiàn suǒ . chén yǔ yǐ wéi tiē le zhǐ , hòu lái dào de rén jiù néng zhǎo dào xiǎo tīng . lín ān què shí kàn jiàn le zhǐ , kě fēng bǎ zhǐ chuī qǐ lái , tā méi kàn qīng nèi róng . rú guǒ wǒ men zhǐ tīng kàn jiàn yī zhāng zhǐ , jiù huì lòu diào hòu bàn jù . kàn jiàn zhǐ hé dú dào tōng zhī bù shì tóng yī jiàn shì , jiù xiàng fā guò xiāo xī hé duì fāng kàn guò xiāo xī yě bù shì tóng yī jiàn shì .
audio.en: The entrance notice is a third clue. Chen expected later arrivals to find the small hall from it. Lin saw the paper, but the wind lifted it and she could not read the contents. Seeing paper differs from reading a notice, just as sending a message differs from the other person reading it.

tasks.statement: Seeing the paper proves Lin read its contents.
tasks.why: The wind prevented her from reading it.

prompt.zh: 你十点手机就没电，十点零五分发的消息为什么没回？
prompt.py: nǐ shí diǎn shǒu jī jiù méi diàn , shí diǎn líng wǔ fēn fā de xiāo xī wèi shén me méi huí ?
prompt.en: Your phone died at ten. Why was there no reply to the message sent at 10:05?

choices: 手机没电，我没看到；不是故意不回。
我十点零五分已经看完，只是没回。
我十点半手机才没电，之前还看过。
tasks.answer: 手机没电，我没看到；不是故意不回。
tasks.why: The reply gives a concrete reason without treating sending as reading.

prompt.zh: 这次发完消息没有等回复。下次怎样确认对方收到？
prompt.py: zhè cì fā wán xiāo xī méi yǒu děng huí fù . xià cì zěn yàng què rèn duì fāng shōu dào ?
prompt.en: We did not wait for a reply this time. How can we confirm receipt next time?

choices: 等对方回一句，再确认是哪扇门。
看到自己发出，就算对方已经读过。
等对方到了，再把新地址发出去。
tasks.answer: 等对方回一句，再确认是哪扇门。
tasks.why: Acknowledgement and an entrance description address the actual failure.

prompt.zh: 你只说没看见她，还没确认。怎么知道她没来？
prompt.py: nǐ zhǐ shuō méi kàn jiàn tā , hái méi què rèn . zěn me zhī dào tā méi lái ?
prompt.en: You only said you did not see her, without checking. How do you know she did not come?

choices: 我只是没看见她，还得确认。
我还没确认，但已经确定她没到。
我看到她在门口，所以她根本没来。
tasks.answer: 我只是没看见她，还得确认。
tasks.why: Not seeing someone alone does not prove absence.

line.zh: 直到电话接通，他【才】知道我在门口。
line.py: zhí dào diàn huà jiē tōng , tā cái zhī dào wǒ zài mén kǒu .
line.en: Only when the call connected did he know I was at the entrance.

line.zh: 我把发过消息【当成】对方看过。
line.py: wǒ bǎ fā guò xiāo xī dàng chéng duì fāng kàn guò .
line.en: I treated sending the message as the other person having read it.

line.py: wǒ zǒng suàn zhǎo dào nǐ men le .
